heading: INT. MATTRESS SHOWROOM, BACK OFFICE - DAY

units.text: INT. MATTRESS SHOWROOM, BACK OFFICE - DAY
A windowless room behind rows of beds.
A desk, three chairs, a poster of a smiling sheep.
The air smells of fresh foam and old coffee.
MORTON GRIGGS, fifties, in a short-sleeved shirt and a tie that has lost an argument with a stapler, sits behind the desk.
He is the store manager.
Facing him, in matching chairs, are DELPHINE ABERNATHY, thirties, an assistant manager with a binder, and WALLACE "WALLY" TSUJI, twenties, a salesman with a neck brace.
Morton folds his hands.
He looks at both of them, and he sighs.
We are here to resolve a grievance.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: I filed the grievance.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: I filed the counter-grievance.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: There's a form for that?
units.name: MORTON

units.text: There is now.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Wally shifts.
His neck brace creaks.
He glares at Delphine, then at the sheep poster, as though looking for an ally.
Is it fair to say that a man has a right to nap on a display bed?
units.name: WALLY

units.text: No.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: Even during a lull?
units.name: WALLY

units.text: Especially during a lull.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: He was snoring, Morton. Customers thought it was the Sleep Number demo.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: The Sleep Number demo was broken.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: Because you broke it.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: I fell asleep on it. That's different.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: How is that different?
units.name: MORTON

units.text: I wasn't being malicious.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: You were being unconscious.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Okay. Okay. Let me read the incident report.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: Morton picks up a sheet of paper.
Delphine slides her binder forward an inch.
Wally leans back and the neck brace creaks again.
"At 2:14 PM, Mr. Tsuji was observed in Display Bed Nine, horizontal, with a pillow over his face."
units.name: MORTON

units.text: It was a decorative pillow.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: "Customers were advised that the model was a sample of our new Eternal Rest line."
units.name: MORTON

units.text: Several customers wished to purchase it.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Wait. They did?
units.name: MORTON

units.text: Four units. A man from the funeral home on Fifth asked about wholesale.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Well.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: That's a win.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: It is not a win. It's a liability.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: It's a win and a liability. Both can be true.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: That's what I've been saying.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: You have not been saying that. You have been saying "zzz."
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Let's focus. Delphine, what do you want?
units.name: MORTON

units.text: A written apology. And I want him to stop sleeping in the store.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Wally?
units.name: MORTON

units.text: I want my sick days restored. And a new neck brace. This one pinches.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: Why do you need a neck brace?
units.name: MORTON

units.text: I fell off the bed.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: He rolled off Bed Nine during a nap and tried to file a worker's comp claim.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: It's a claim, Delphine. We have to hear it.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: Hear it? He was asleep.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: It was a work-related sleep. I was dreaming about quotas.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: Wally, that's not a thing.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: It is if you're committed.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: Morton rubs his temples.
He picks up a pen and writes something.
He tears the page from the pad and hands it to Delphine, then writes another and hands it to Wally.
What's this?
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Your apology.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: What's this?
units.name: WALLY

units.text: Yours.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: I don't owe him an apology.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: You gave him a Sleep Number quote he couldn't afford.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: That was a clerical error.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: So is this. Sign.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: They sign.
Morton collects the papers.
He stands, and the chair rolls back into the filing cabinet with a bang.
The sheep on the poster goes on smiling.
Meeting adjourned. Everyone back to the floor.
units.name: MORTON

units.text: Can I sit down on a bed first?
units.name: WALLY

units.text: No.
units.name: MORTON
